functionalRequirement: User shall be able to share files, screen share, conduct group screen sharing, and send contacts.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support all common file formats (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, JPEG, PNG, MP4) for file sharing with 100% compatibility.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires file sharing functionality, which necessitates support for standard file formats to ensure complete functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must initiate screen sharing within 2 seconds of user request under normal network conditions (>5 Mbps).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Screen sharing is a real-time feature requiring quick response times to maintain user engagement and usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support group screen sharing with up to 50 concurrent viewers while maintaining a frame rate of at least 15 fps at 720p resolution.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Group screen sharing requires sufficient capacity to handle multiple viewers without significant degradation in quality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: File sharing operations must complete the upload/download process at a minimum of 80% of the available network bandwidth.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource utilization is necessary for timely file sharing operations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide clear visual indicators for active screen sharing sessions, with distinct states for individual and group sharing modes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Users need to easily recognize when screen sharing is active to prevent unintentional sharing of sensitive information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The file sharing interface must allow users to select and share files in no more than 3 clicks/taps from any main screen.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Streamlined operability is essential for frequent file sharing actions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must maintain screen sharing connections with 99.5% uptime during active sessions, automatically reconnecting within 5 seconds if disconnection occurs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Reliable connectivity is crucial for screen sharing functionality to be effective.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: All shared files must be scanned for malware before being made available to recipients, with detection rates matching industry standards (>98%).
identifiedNFRs.justification: File sharing introduces security risks that must be mitigated to protect users.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Screen sharing sessions must implement end-to-end encryption using AES-256 to protect content during transmission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Screen content may contain sensitive information requiring protection from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The file sharing and screen sharing features must function consistently across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android operating systems with identical core functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Cross-platform compatibility is essential for sharing features in a diverse device ecosystem.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The screen sharing module must be implemented as a separate component with well-defined interfaces, allowing for independent updates without affecting other system components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Modular design facilitates maintenance and updates to the screen sharing functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must support scaling to handle a 200% increase in concurrent screen sharing sessions without requiring architectural changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Scalability is important to accommodate growth in user base and usage patterns.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to sign up and validate credentials, leading to access to the Snap camera screen.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must validate 100% of user credentials against all defined validation rules (e.g., password complexity, email format) with appropriate feedback for each validation failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Credential validation is a core aspect of the sign-up process that requires comprehensive rule enforcement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The sign-up process must complete within 3 seconds (from submission to confirmation) under normal load conditions (up to 1000 concurrent sign-ups).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Quick response times during sign-up are essential to prevent user abandonment of the process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must transition to the Snap camera screen within 1 second after successful credential validation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Rapid access to the camera screen after authentication maintains user engagement and flow.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The sign-up form must clearly indicate all required fields and provide real-time validation feedback for each field as the user completes it.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Immediate feedback improves the user experience and reduces errors during sign-up.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must provide password strength indicators that update in real-time as users create passwords, with clear visual differentiation between weak, medium, and strong passwords.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Password strength indicators help users create secure credentials while understanding security requirements.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The sign-up and credential validation system must maintain 99.9% availability during peak usage hours (defined as 8 AM to 10 PM in each supported time zone).
identifiedNFRs.justification: High availability is critical for user acquisition and onboarding processes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User passwords must be stored using bcrypt with a minimum work factor of 10, never in plaintext or using reversible encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Secure password storage is essential to protect user credentials from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement rate limiting that restricts failed sign-up attempts to no more than 5 per minute from a single IP address to prevent brute force attacks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Rate limiting protects against automated attacks targeting the sign-up process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must enforce multi-factor authentication for new account creation, requiring verification through email or phone before granting access to the Snap camera screen.
identifiedNFRs.justification: MFA adds an essential layer of security to verify user identity during account creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The authentication system must be implemented as a separate service with a well-documented API, allowing for updates to authentication methods without modifying the camera access components.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Modular design facilitates maintenance and security updates to the authentication system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The sign-up system must support the addition of new authentication methods (e.g., social media login, biometric authentication) without requiring changes to the core credential validation logic.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Adaptability to evolving authentication technologies and user preferences is important for long-term viability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: The system must implement secure access controls that prevent unauthorized camera activation, requiring explicit user permission before enabling the Snap camera functionality.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Camera access has privacy implications requiring safety measures to prevent misuse or unintended activation.
